counterexample_interpretations.interpretation: Block rates stay 10 and 1 per 1000 usable land-cell-days in both periods. Only the share of usable observations moves (0.8/0.2 to 0.2/0.8), and the pooled index moves from 8.2 to 2.8 (-65.85%). Fixed 0.5/0.5 weights give 5.5 in both periods. A missing or zero-support block makes the fixed-weight result unavailable; weights are never renormalized and missing is never zero.
counterexample_interpretations.label: Composition shift: observed -65.85% with unchanged block rates
limits: Equal weights are illustrative, not a registered default; R_std is a different estimand.
zero_support_reasons: required block 'low' has zero usable support (O = 0)

counterexample_interpretations.interpretation: British Columbia's share of the combined usable land-cell-days changes by year (Aqua: 0.541 (2022) to 0.579 (2023); VIIRS: 0.562 (2022) to 0.599 (2023)). A pooled two-region rate therefore weights the regions differently each year, which alone can move it (plan Section 4B). The pooled-rate identity holds in 16 of 16 sensor-years. Each region was fitted separately; no union factor was fitted or evaluated.
counterexample_interpretations.label: British Columbia + California: usable-observation shares move between years
limits: Accounting check of summed counts, not a calibrated or evaluated union.
Shares are of usable land-cell-days in eligible weeks, not of fires or FIRMS points.

counterexample_interpretations.effect_definition: Delta(a) = a*V - B; B = Aqua pooled rate, V = raw VIIRS pooled rate, both 1000*sum(D)/sum(O) over the same eligible weeks; a_break = B/V
counterexample_interpretations.interpretation: British Columbia, own-support a_H: the registered variants span 1.5440 to 1.5628. The factor that would make mapped VIIRS equal Aqua (a_break = B/V) lies outside that span in 5 of 5 periods (2019 development, 2022-2025 applicability). Every variant maps VIIRS above Aqua in 2, below in 3, and the variants straddle equality in 0. Without a correction (a = 1) VIIRS is below Aqua in 5 of 5.
counterexample_interpretations.label: British Columbia, a_H: equality value outside the variant range in 5 of 5 periods
limits: Descriptive. No applicability criterion is registered, so 2022-2025 stay insufficient_evidence: neither passed nor failed.
The variant span is a leave-one-year-out sensitivity set, not a confidence interval or physical bound.
Rates are fire-cell-days per 1000 usable land-cell-days, not fire counts or FIRMS points.
counterexample_interpretations.variant_envelope_note: Min-max of registered leave-one-year-out variants; not a confidence interval or physical bound.
